review:
The swingier twin of Le Football Fan – same stadium, same Smokey rallying the crowd, but a much bigger ceiling. Cluster wins become Marked Squares that turn into Coins, Clovers and Buckets of Gold.

Three, four or five FS symbols trigger one of three bonuses. Rated 3/5 with a 10,000x max – four times Le Football Fan's – and RTP versions of 96.34%, 94.23% and 92.17%. Pick this one if you love the theme but want a bigger top prize.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 92.17% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
